title: Calling an LLM over Raw HTTP

questions.question: What does an LLM SDK call like client.chat.completions.create(...) ultimately do?
options: Sends one JSON body in an HTTP POST and parses the JSON response
questions.explanation: SDKs build the request body, add auth headers, POST it, and parse the reply, plus retries and helpers.

questions.question: In the Anthropic Messages API, where does the system prompt go?
questions.explanation: Anthropic takes system as its own field; the messages list holds only user and assistant turns.

questions.question: How do you send a tool's result back in the Anthropic format?
options: A tool_result block inside a user message, with the matching tool_use_id
questions.explanation: Tool results are user-turn content blocks. Several results from one turn go into one user message.

questions.question: In OpenAI-format tool calls, what type is function.arguments?
options: A string containing JSON, which you must json.loads (and which can be malformed)
questions.explanation: OpenAI sends arguments as a JSON-encoded string. Anthropic's tool_use.input is already an object.

questions.question: You get "roles must alternate between user and assistant" from Anthropic after two parallel tool calls. Likely cause?
options: Each tool result was sent as its own user message, creating two user turns in a row; merge them into one
questions.explanation: Consecutive tool results must share one user message containing multiple tool_result blocks.

questions.question: Why normalize both providers' responses into one Reply type?
options: So agent code (loops, tools, evals) works with any provider without branching on the wire format
questions.explanation: Normalizing at the boundary keeps provider differences in one adapter instead of spread through the agent.
